messages:
maya: Hey team — I've addressed the comments from review on PR #3421. Summary:
- fix: handle empty KV chunk in serializer
- test: added unit + integration test that reproduces the failure
- docs: note about test-only timeout tweak

PTAL @sam @tess. I scoped the timeout bump to the failing test only (see snippet below).

```python
# tests/test_serializer.py
assert process(items, timeout_ms=120) == expected
```

I'm hoping to merge today if CI stays green and we can grab a quick canary slot.

sam: Thanks — quick question: why 120ms? can we make it deterministic by mocking the timer instead? If it's only to avoid flakiness in CI I'd prefer mocking so we don't change assumptions in other tests.

tess: also saw one tiny nit inline about the assertion style — otherwise LGTM.

maya: Good call, sam. I tried mocking first but the failure only reproduces under real scheduling on the infra runners. Scoped the change to the single flaky test and left a comment explaining why. Pushed a follow-up commit and force-pushed the branch.

maya: Patch note: replaced the flaky `sleep()`-based gap with a short `retry_until` helper in that test, but kept the timeout window at 120ms to cover infra jitter. Link to commit: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/3421/commits/abc123

tess: ran the branch locally, unit + integration pass for me. Nit: prefer `expect(x).to.equal(true)` over `to.be.true` for clearer diffs. PTAL after you change that.

maya: Done — updated assertion, pushed. CI triggered.

ci-bot: GitHub Actions — All checks passed ✅ (build, unit, integration). e2e had one flaky failure but retried and passed.

sam: OK from me once CI is green. I'll hold the merge until the 15:00 canary window so ops can monitor.

tess: Approved. :shipit:

maya: thanks both — scheduling merge for 15:00 canary. I'll post an update if anything breaks.
